name: Creatures of the Night
disable: DC 24 Nature check or DC 24 Religion check (trained) to scatter the vermin; two successes are required to disable it
routine: (1 action) The bats and rats bite all creatures in the room, doing 2d8+3 piercing damage (DC 24 basic Reflex save save). On a failure, the creature also takes 3 persistent,bleed damage.

items.name: Infest
items.text:
Trigger Ezio summons the swarms

---
Effect The swarms coalesce in nauseating fashion. Each creature in the room must succeed at a DC 24 Fortitude save save or become Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). The hazard then rolls initiative.

text: Bats and rats swarm around Ezio's enemies.
